integration_issues.issue: Could not visually verify pw-sponsorship-badge-pwc_2f916cd9261047 badge OR pw-sponsorship-brand-asset-pwc_2f916cd9261047 modal block via automated Playwright. Root cause: /api/predict-win/active is paginated (20 items/page, has_more=true), the seeded Nike parent pwc_2f916cd9261047 lives on PAGE 4 of the consumer feed, and the /predict-win page does not appear to auto-paginate on scroll — after 8 window.scrollBy(0,2000) iterations the DOM still did NOT contain the seed parent ID, and the page tail rendered 'Browse all radio channels' (below-feed content). The badge component + testids are present in source (/app/frontend/src/components/PredictWinSponsorBadge.jsx and PredictWin.jsx ActiveCard/EnterModal). This is a testability/pagination gap — visual proof needs either (a) infinite-scroll fix on /predict-win, or (b) moving the seeded parent to page 1 (e.g., by boosting its start_time), or (c) opening the seed parent via a direct /predict-win/{id} URL if such a route exists.

issues: Pre-existing recurring React console warning: 'A props object containing a key prop is being spread into JSX' (NavItem in AdvertiserShell). Not AD.3-specific.

action_items: Consider adding infinite-scroll / load-more on /predict-win, OR bumping the seeded Nike-sponsored parent (pwc_2f916cd9261047) to page 1 of the consumer feed so the sponsor badge and EnterModal brand-asset block become visually reachable without deep pagination. This will unblock badge/modal visual verification in future test iterations.
critical_code_review_comments: ad3_sponsorship_service.record_event: after a race that returns already_billed, the debit compensation uses $inc: budget_available_cents:+billed and budget_spent_cents:-billed — verified correct, but note the compensation is BEST-EFFORT and does not retry on transient failure. Under sustained wallet-drain races there is a theoretical risk of a leaked +billed wallet delta. Not exploitable in normal flow (idempotency prevents multi-fire per user/sponsorship/event_type), but worth a comment in the code.

ad3_sponsorship_service.active_sponsorship_for_parent auction: candidates.sort with random.random() in the key achieves random tiebreak but breaks total ordering — priority_boost/billing are the primary sorters so this is safe, but formally the key returns a mixed tuple where random appears at index 2. Consider (priority_boost, billing, random.random()) is fine given reverse=True and stable behavior — no functional issue observed in tests.

ad3_sponsorships route validation: create body enforces budget_cents>=100 via pydantic (Field ge=100) which returns HTTP 422, NOT the 400 budget_too_small error code specified in the AD.3 review request. Both are technically 'reject', but the code path never reaches _validate's budget_too_small ValueError. If the intent is a 400 with code=budget_too_small, drop the pydantic ge=100 constraint. Minor — matches HTTP semantics either way.

ad3_sponsorship_service publish_sponsorship does not check current status before flipping to pending_admin. An already-live or paused sponsorship could theoretically be re-published; consider adding: if doc['status'] not in ('draft','rejected','requires_changes'): raise cannot_publish_status.

Frontend PredictWin consumer feed pagination is not testable via scroll — pagination hook may need review to enable infinite scroll or a visible 'Load more' button (which today falls straight into 'Browse all radio channels' at the bottom without loading pages 2+).

rca of the issue: Consumer badge/modal visual gap RCA: /api/predict-win/active returns paginated 20-per-page (total=63, has_more=true). Seed parent pwc_2f916cd9261047 is on page=4 by start_time DESC ordering. Playwright test scrolled window 8x by 2000px each but the DOM did not load additional pages — the /predict-win React page appears to not implement infinite-scroll / IntersectionObserver-based pagination. Reproduction: navigate to /predict-win as demo user, scroll to the bottom — you land on 'Browse all radio channels' section (below the feed) without ever loading pages 2-4. Mitigation: main agent to either wire infinite-scroll to the ActiveCards feed or bump the seed sponsor's parent start_time to be more recent so it lands on page 1.
